findings.title: Malformed or missing message.attributes can crash the consumer on final failure
findings.evidence: On the final failed attempt, the DLQ payload unconditionally expands message.attributes into a dict. If attributes is None or any non-mapping value, this raises before dlq.send is called, escapes the inner try/except, and aborts process_messages instead of retrying or leaving the message for redelivery.
findings.recommendation: Normalize attributes before use, e.g. treat non-dict values as {} in both _delivery_attempts and the DLQ send path, or wrap construction of the attributes dict inside the inner try/except so malformed metadata cannot terminate the worker.
